Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: Indian jewellery storefront Wedding occasion card.
Generate ONE new photograph, output 1024 x 1536 pixels, portrait 2:3.
A strikingly beautiful adult Tamil South Indian woman, approximately 28 years old, photographed naturally during a quiet wedding preparation moment in a real Chettinad home. Elegant burgundy and muted antique-gold Kanchipuram silk saree, jasmine flowers in a tidy bun, small bindi. She wears refined, physically credible 22K gold jewellery: one beautifully crafted bridal necklace with a modest central pendant, matching medium jhumka earrings and several bangles. The jewellery is clearly visible and attractive, with readable craftsmanship and restrained reflections.
Composition: medium-long shot from above the head to mid-thigh, camera several steps back. Entire head visible with 10 percent top breathing space; shoulders comfortably inside the frame. Body occupies about 60 percent of image width. Keep face, both earrings and necklace within the central 60 percent crop-safe area for a narrow website card. One hand rests loosely near her waist holding the saree pallu; the other rests naturally by her side. She looks slightly to the side with a small authentic closed-mouth smile. Bottom 18 percent is calm saree/background, suitable for an existing website title overlay. Do NOT draw the title or dark gradient.
Photography: candid luxury campaign photo by an experienced human photographer, 50mm lens at f/4, soft indirect daylight from an actual side window, neutral accurate skin colour and subdued warm interior background. A softly out-of-focus wooden pillar and textured plaster wall give authentic context. No luminous fairy lights, excessive bokeh or ornate palace fantasy.
Natural visible pores and fine facial hair, gentle under-eye texture, subtle facial asymmetry, tiny stray hair strands, realistic eye catchlights, natural lips and teeth, understated professional makeup. Preserve skin texture and normal fabric creases. Anatomically convincing hands with five fingers, believable necklace drape and earrings attached properly. Polished but lightly retouched, believable real camera exposure, fine photographic grain.
Avoid plastic waxy skin, airbrushing, CGI or 3D render appearance, beauty filters, orange colour grading, theatrical glamour lighting, impossible jewellery details, oversized jewellery, fake glitter, tight face close-up, cut-off head, duplicated fingers. No text, logos, frames, borders, watermark or collage. Opaque photographic background.
